retained_boundaries: Current combat copies loot_table metadata but this source search found no generic post-combat loot-table settlement; actual campaign/generated/event grants are separate. No new loot behavior is asserted.

Currency wrappers follow different current hosts: dungeon rewards special-case gold_ IDs; EventResolver give_item calls inventory.add_item. Reconcile actual reward receipts before promoting a unified currency definition.
Tactical key/contents records are item consumers; doors, chests, trap payloads, creature bodies and room-state authoring stay in the world/creature pass.

Pact of Blade binding can use a magic weapon actually found; it does not make every dormant magic-weapon shell reachable or grant its template. No currently named Crown root supplies those dormant shells.

Craft lists in equipment candidates retain potential outputs. Selecting every generic craftable object, magic crafting recipe or wished-for item is not this finite acquisition pass; preserve those dependencies for the appropriate selected procedure.
